description: 한국전자통신연구원_언어 분석 기술 API [telecommunications] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국전자통신연구원. 언어 분석 기술은 자연어 문장의 의미를 이해하기 위한 기술로, 단어의 형태와 의미 및 문장의 구조와 의미를 분석하여 지식처리를 위한 기반 기술로 활용됩니다. 언어 분석을 위한 6종의 API는 HTTP 기반의 REST API 인터페이스로 JSON 포맷 기반의 입력 및 출력을 지원하며 ETRI에서 제공하는... Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 한국전자통신연구원. Its tags are 언어분석, 어휘관계, 형태소분석, 과학기술. It offers 1 resource(s) in json. The portal shows 2025-07-29 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
